To Lily,

To be completely honest with my self, with everyone in this conversation who will listen, I still love you. I'm not taken along by the torrent of my emotions as I once was when I was a younger me, but I still have a place of love for you in my heart. I think of you from time to time, I wonder about the hypotheticals, and I ask myself sometimes how you're doing. I can't shake the feeling that in another life, in another set of circumstances, we would have grown old together. Imagine it, our grey hair and loose wrinkles, the moments we could describe. Some we could laugh about, others I'm sure we'd rather forget, but that at the end of the day, we would look in the other's eyes and smile because it says between us more than what words ever could. That of course isn't this life, but an extension of my imagination. Whether or not that was honestly likely or not, I'll never know, and that's ok; I'm fine with that.

I've grown out of my old skin since we parted ways, and to be pragmatic, we'll probably never talk again, but I'll always think of you. That too has meaning. You'll always be the one who got away, and whether that sentiment is shared or not is irrelevant. That I knew you as I once did, that I have the stories that we wrote together to reflect on in going forward in this life, is something that will always matter to me, and that in itself is enough. I just wanted to say this to you, I just wanted you to know that the memories I hold of us are special to me, even if I'll never have the chance to actually tell you.

May your future be forever bright and enduring,

E.
